name: Notifybar
description: Displays a site-wide notification bar message (announcement banner) via a block.
project_description:
Notifybar module provide you functionality to show the notification bar at the page top and bottom. The block with name "Notifybar" to show on the site.

 How to use: 

 Download and extract files in module folder.

Enable module from module list

Go to Home » Administration » Structure » Block layout» Add Notifybar Block

Add your message, button text, button link, background colour and text colour.

If you want to hide the notification bar from top then select the none option from "Show notifybar" bar drop-down.

You can use the block("Notifybar") to show in the specific region

Clear drupal caches in fully theme-able colored horizontal bars on top of the page.

 INSTALLATION 

 - Install via /admin/modules

- drush en notifybar -y

- composer require drupal/notifybar
